title: Colour sentence frames and noun sort
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Common vocabulary: numbers, colours, clothes and shapes
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 14 (Colour sentence frames and noun sort (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 14: Describing things with colours. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: The thing is red
points: القَلَمُ أَحْمَرُ (al-qalamu ahmaru): the pen is red
السَّيَّارَةُ بَيْضَاءُ: the car is white
al- on the noun, no al- on the colour: a full sentence

blocks.title: Sort into: Masculine colour / Feminine colour
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Masculine colour, Feminine colour.
blocks.answer: Masculine colour: قَلَم; بَاب; كِتَاب; قَمِيص. Feminine colour: سَيَّارَة; حَقِيبَة; طَاوِلَة; وَرْدَة

parts.text: بَاب has no ة: masculine, so هٰذَا. White masculine: أَبْيَض. Colour after the noun: هٰذَا بَابٌ أَبْيَضُ.

questions.q: Say: This is a white door (بَاب).
Say: This is a yellow flower (وَرْدَة).
Core: Write five sentences describing things in your room with هٰذَا or هٰذِهِ and a colour.
questions.a: For example: هٰذَا كِتَابٌ أَزْرَقُ. هٰذِهِ حَقِيبَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ. هٰذَا بَابٌ أَبْيَضُ. هٰذِهِ طَاوِلَةٌ بُنِّيَّةٌ. هٰذَا قَلَمٌ أَحْمَرُ.

questions.q: Extend: Turn two of your sentences into 'the ... is ...' sentences.
questions.a: For example: الكِتَابُ أَزْرَقُ. الحَقِيبَةُ سَوْدَاءُ.

questions.q: Stretch: Describe the flag of a Muslim country in Arabic (colours only).
questions.a: For example: عَلَمُ تُرْكِيَا أَحْمَرُ وَأَبْيَضُ.

questions.q: Which is correct for 'this is a green book'?
questions.a: B) هٰذَا كِتَابٌ أَخْضَرُ. كِتَاب is masculine: هٰذَا and أَخْضَرُ, colour after the noun.

questions.q: Where does the colour go in Arabic? A) before the noun B) after the noun
Big question: describe something near you with its colour in Arabic.
